A.title: Will there be a recession in 2027?
A.subtitle: Yes
A.primary: If there are two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth in Q4 2026 through Q4 2027, according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, then the market resolves to Yes.
A.secondary:
For the avoidance of doubt, qualifying consecutive quarters may include Q4 2026 and Q1 2027.

GDP growth refers to the quarter-over-quarter annualized percent change in real GDP as reported in the Advance Estimate for each quarter.

The market will close at the sooner of the occurrence of the event or 8:25 AM ET on the morning of the expected release of the Advance Estimate of 2027 Q4 GDP. The market will expire at the sooner of the occurrence of the event or the first 10:00 AM ET after the release of the Advance Estimate of 2027 Q4 GDP.
A.coverage: Official market API fields only; full governing terms and historical version not certified.

B.title: Donald Trump out before 2027?
B.subtitle: Before 2027
B.primary: If Donald Trump leaves office before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
B.secondary:
An announcement that the President will leave the office within the next year is also encompassed by the Payout Criterion. An acknowledgement by Donald Trump that they will leave office due solely to the scheduled expiration of a constitutionally or legally mandated term limit does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

If Donald Trump leaves solely because they have died, the associated market will resolve and the Exchange will determine the payouts to the holders of long and short positions based upon the last traded price (prior to the death). If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.
B.coverage: Official market API fields only; full governing terms and historical version not certified.

B.title: Will there be exactly 1 Fed rate hike in 2026?

B.primary: If the number of rate hikes by the Federal Open Market Committee during calendar year 2026 is exactly 1, then the market resolves to Yes.

A.title: Donald Trump out before 2027?
A.subtitle: Before 2027
A.primary: If Donald Trump leaves office before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
A.secondary:
An announcement that the President will leave the office within the next year is also encompassed by the Payout Criterion. An acknowledgement by Donald Trump that they will leave office due solely to the scheduled expiration of a constitutionally or legally mandated term limit does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

If Donald Trump leaves solely because they have died, the associated market will resolve and the Exchange will determine the payouts to the holders of long and short positions based upon the last traded price (prior to the death). If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.
A.coverage: Official market API fields only; full governing terms and historical version not certified.
